When you open a member-only story you can\'t read, it opens through Freedium automatically. Stories you can read as a member stay on Medium. Detection is best-effort; the "Read free" button always works.
Open Medium links in this app
Opens Android settings → turn on "Open supported links" and add medium.com, so tapping a Medium link opens here.
Clear cookies and sign out of medium.com in this app?
Change this if Freedium moves to a new domain.
Open Settings → Apps → Freedium → Open by default
Watches only the Medium app and floats a "Read free" bubble on member-only articles. It reads on-screen text on your device to detect the paywall; nothing is sent anywhere.
Floating button over the Medium app

Shows a draggable "Read free" bubble when the Medium app opens a member-only story. Tapping it uses Medium\'s own Share to hand the link to Freedium. It works only with the Medium app installed, needs the two permissions below, and reads screen text on-device only.
● Active — open a member-only story in the Medium app
Setup: %1$s draw over apps · %2$s enable watcher
Allow "draw over other apps" in settings to show the bubble
Find "Medium paywall watcher" under Installed apps and turn it on
Open Medium\'s Share, then pick "Read on Freedium"
